title: Office Cryptids You'll Meet at Work: Be honest — how many office cryptid do you have?
caption:
Be honest — how many office cryptid do you have?

You've seen every one of these. Denial is free:
1️⃣ The Kitchen Bandit — Your labeled lunch is gone. No camera caught them. Coworkers speak of them in whispers near the fridge.
2️⃣ The Meeting Mumble — Speaks only during mandatory calls, always on mute-adjacent audio. Nobody has heard a full sentence yet.
3️⃣ The Printer Whisperer — One person in every office can fix the printer. They never asked for this power. They can never leave now.
4️⃣ The Calendar Ghost — Books 60-minute meetings that end in 12. Legend says they once finished one early. Nobody believes it.

Tag the friend who is #1 (they won't admit it).
